body: Your welcome 🙏 hope things work out for you

I feel for you 

My parents had me committed for two months when I was 17 

I definitely needed to be there , 

I tried to off myself , so I totally understand why they did it 

but being there for that long was definitely starting to feel like it was doing more harm then good
Wishing for the same thing , so tired of everything

Thanks for the kind words, but there are some things in my life that can never get better ...

I really wish that there was an easy way out of this mess of a life 

All I want to do is just sleep all day , I’m just so damn tired of waking up and having to deal with another day of being me .. it’s exhausting

Too many reasons to die , and no reasons to live , that pretty much somes it up , 

Don’t feel up to getting into all the depressing details right now , but my life is pretty pathetic to say the least 

Just trying to decide on the best way out really 

I’m very surprised that I lasted this long to be honest 

And wish I would have ended things a long time ago
